name: Amen Packaging Inc
old_description: Amen Packaging  has been defining packaging excellence since 1979.  Spanning multiple industries, we provide quality design, implementation and delivery of package and container solutions.
about:
Amen Packaging Inc. has operated from Denver, Colorado since its founding in 1979. The business began in a modest space beneath a busy highway and has since expanded to a newer central Denver location while remaining a locally rooted enterprise.

The company functions as a wholesale distributor of rigid packaging containers — including Boston rounds, amber glass bottles, woozy bottles, jars, cans, and pails — and provides custom printing and labeling services. It offers packaging design consultation, implementation, and delivery, positioning itself as a turnkey supplier for container solutions. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Amen Packaging serves the paint and coatings, food and co‑packing, chemical, general industrial, cosmetic, wine and spirits, and health and pharmaceutical sectors. Its customer base includes industrial manufacturers, co‑packers, and brand owners requiring regulatory‑compliant containers for hazardous materials, food‑grade products, and export shipments.

The firm emphasizes its 45‑plus years of service to the Rocky Mountain region and a philosophy that industrial packaging should reduce risk rather than add cost. It differentiates itself through custom bottle and labeling development, a $200 minimum purchase threshold for wholesale orders, and an appointment‑only will‑call pickup system. The company also notes its status as a Denver Broncos Small Business Partner.

name: America Wood Solutions
old_description: Serving homeowners, contractors, and hospitality teams with precision cabinetry, CNC-driven millwork, and reliable project execution.
about:
America Wood Solutions was founded in 1996 in Streamwood, Illinois, as a family-owned custom woodworking and cabinetry shop. The company has operated continuously from its suburban Chicago location for nearly three decades.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and casework using CNC-driven machining. Its capabilities span plastic-laminate and wood construction for projects ranging from single residential kitchens to multi-site hospitality rollouts. The company reports more than 1,000 completed projects since inception.

America Wood Solutions serves three primary markets: hospitality, commercial, and residential. Hospitality clients include hotel groups and property managers needing brand-consistent casework for guest rooms, front desks, and public areas. Commercial customers encompass office fit-outs, barbershops, salons, retail interiors, and back-of-house utility spaces. Residential work covers custom kitchens, bathrooms, built-ins, and whole-home storage. General contractors and builders rely on the firm for coordinated millwork packages that align with project schedules.

The company emphasizes precision, durability, and long-term performance over first-day appearance. Its stated approach centers on understanding scope, building to spec with consistency, communicating clearly, and delivering work that holds up over time. The family-owned structure is cited as a foundation for accountability and client-focused service.

about:
American Auto Parts Superstore operates from Los Lunas, New Mexico, where it maintains a physical address NW. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available materials.

The business functions as an online retailer of genuine automotive parts and accessories, offering original equipment manufacturer (OEM) components alongside interior and exterior accessories. Its e-commerce platform allows customers to search by part number, keyword, or vehicle identification number (VIN), and the site is powered by RevolutionParts software. The company does not manufacture products; it sources and resells parts for a wide range of vehicle makes and models.

The primary customer base consists of individual vehicle owners and automotive enthusiasts seeking replacement parts or upgrades for new and older vehicles. The company serves the automotive aftermarket retail sector, shipping orders directly to consumers across the United States.

The company states that its commitment to customer service and satisfaction drives an effort to keep parts and accessories as affordable as possible. This pricing focus, combined with a searchable catalog and direct-to-consumer shipping, forms the basis of its market positioning.

name: American Cable & Electronics, inc
old_description: Manufacturer of Custom Cables and Cable Assemblies for the OEM Market
about:
Based in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin, American Cable & Electronics, Inc. (ACE) operates as a manufacturer of custom cable assemblies and electro-mechanical assemblies for original equipment manufacturers. The company focuses on low- to mid-volume production runs and rapid prototyping of complex electromechanical designs.

ACE’s capabilities span engineering, rapid prototyping, and manufacturing of electromechanical assemblies that integrate plastics, sheet metal, electronics, cable assemblies, and plastic injection over-molded parts. The facility handles projects ranging from simple wire harnesses to fully finished assemblies with embedded circuits or over-molded PCBs, and offers turn-key electro-mechanical project management. Services include design for manufacturability, design assistance, material analysis and testing, tooling development, and CAD support.

The company serves medical electronics, industrial controls, commercial products, and defense sectors, including the U.S. and Canadian Departments of Defense. Its customer base includes Tier 1 medical device suppliers and top OEMs in medical, industrial, and commercial markets.

ACE differentiates itself through a global materials procurement strategy aimed at delivering the right components at the right time, a quality system certified to ISO 9001 and compliant with IPC/WHMA-A-620 and UL/CSA standards, and a focus on low-volume over-molding with flexible tooling. The company emphasizes process controls to ensure every product is manufactured correctly the first time.

name: American Cable Products LLC
old_description: Delivering excellence in communication connectivity since 2002
about:
American Cable Products LLC was established in November 2002 and is headquartered in Saint Louis, Missouri. The company operates as a minority‑owned business (MBE certified) and provides low‑voltage communication connectivity solutions across all 50 states, Canada, Mexico, and U.S. territories.

The firm delivers end‑to‑end infrastructure services divided into inside‑plant work — structured premise cabling (Cat5e, Cat6, Cat6a, fiber), data‑center design and implementation, hardware configuration, and network infrastructure — and outside‑plant work such as provider connection points, fiber‑optic installations, and campus connectivity. It also integrates security and surveillance systems, including IP camera networks (up to 2,800 cameras on a single project), access control, and biometrics. The company reports nationwide project experience covering more than 500 facilities and 1,000 sites.

Clients span data centers, healthcare, corrections, education, airports, government, retail, and manufacturing. Notable installations include the STL International Airport, a multi‑site healthcare network, a university system, regional retail distribution centers, and an industrial manufacturing complex.

American Cable Products states its mission is to be a one‑stop shop for communication connectivity from provider demarcation to the data center, emphasizing practical, cost‑effective installation and service that exceeds customer expectations. Core values cited are quality, reliability, customer focus, and cost effectiveness.

name: American Circuits
old_description: American Circuits is an electronic contract manufacturer headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina, providing turnkey printed circuit board assembly across two Charlotte facilities.
about:
American Circuits operates from Charlotte, North Carolina, where it has maintained a family-run, minority-owned electronic contract manufacturing business for more than three decades. The company was founded by Vic Gondha, a first-generation immigrant who built the firm after arriving in the United States with a goal of owning a business that could support his family and community. His son, Ket Gondha, now serves as CEO, having expanded the company's Charlotte campus after a career on Wall Street.

The firm provides turnkey printed circuit board assembly from two facilities encompassing roughly 40,000 square feet. Its capabilities span PCB fabrication and assembly (surface-mount, through-hole, and mixed technology), rapid prototyping, conformal coating and potting, automated optical inspection, PCB design and reverse engineering, design-for-manufacturability analysis, bill-of-materials optimization, custom wire harness and cable assembly, and full electro-mechanical integration including box builds and subassemblies. Production runs range from single prototypes to volumes exceeding 100,000 units.

American Circuits serves approximately 400 customers across defense, healthcare, robotics, LED lighting, security and key-control systems, and automotive sectors. Named clients include TE Connectivity, Honda, and Assa Abloy. The company emphasizes a one-stop model that controls the process from bare-board procurement through final assembly and test.

The founder's vision centered on offering both bare boards and turnkey assemblies under one roof—a combination he described as rare in the U.S. market. That end-to-end control, coupled with flexible low-to-high volume runs and ITAR-registered, ISO 9001-certified operations, remains the core differentiator the company highlights today.

name: American Control Electronics
old_description: Displays, Enclosures, Graphics, Labels, Sensors, Connectivity
about:
American Control Electronics (ACE), headquartered in South Beloit, Illinois, with a second facility in Chanhassen, Minnesota, has over 60 years of experience in motor control design and manufacturing. The company operates as a subsidiary of Global Point Technologies Group, a motors, gears, and controls conglomerate.

ACE manufactures electronic motor controls, power products, and custom electronic assemblies. Its capabilities span custom circuit design, PCB design and assembly (PCBA), electronic contract manufacturing (EMS), UL508A control panel assembly, wire harness assembly, box build, testing, and long-term manufacturing support. The Chanhassen facility operates under an ISO 9001:2015-certified quality management system, while the South Beloit site supports UL508A panel assembly and in-house UL testing via the UL Data Acceptance Program. The company also offers flexible circuit technologies, sensor integration, wired and wireless interconnectivity, digital graphics, touch screen interfaces, IoT device design, embedded display controllers, switch actuators, and electronic enclosures.

The company serves OEMs across industrial, food processing, medical, home automation, automotive, agriculture, scientific, oil and gas, and sports markets. Its motor control products include DC, AC (VFD), brushless, stepper, and servo drives, as well as gear reducers and accessories.

ACE emphasizes domestic manufacturing flexibility with two U.S. facilities providing production continuity, and a global network of experts across the Americas and Asia to deliver agile manufacturing without heavy capital investment. Its quality system and UL capabilities are cited as key differentiators.

name: American Electric Components, Inc.
old_description: Manufactures and repairs electrical transformers (single/three-phase, up to 10,000 KVA)
about:
American Electric Components, Inc. has operated from Vernon, California since its founding in 1995. The company is family-owned and operated, drawing on over a century of cumulative experience across its team to design, fabricate, and repair transformers.

The 78,400-square-foot property houses a 47,000-square-foot shop where the company manufactures and repairs single- and three-phase transformers, both dry and oil-filled, with ratings up to 10,000 KVA and 69,000 volts. All units are engineered to meet or exceed NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, and UL standards. The facility also maintains a large inventory of new, rebuilt, and repaired transformers available for immediate sale or rental.

AEC serves utility, industrial, and commercial customers nationwide, including desalination plants requiring desalter transformer overhauls. It holds certified repair-center status from ABB and General Electric, with factory-trained technicians performing service work to original manufacturer standards.

The company emphasizes complete in-house control over the manufacturing process, from initial design through final testing, and highlights short lead times on inverter-duty transformers built with copper windings and advanced core materials. On-site field services such as oil leak repair, electrical testing, and oil sampling round out the offering.

old_description: We carry an extensive selection of respiratory equipment to aid in breathing as well as CPAP and BIPAP supplies for sufferers of sleep apnea.
about:
American Home Medical Equipment Co is based in Lemoyne, Pennsylvania, serving the greater Harrisburg area. Founded in 2011, the company is led by CEO John D. Gilbert and CFO Teresa Gilbert.

The company supplies home medical equipment including respiratory devices, CPAP and BiPAP systems for sleep apnea, mobility assistance products, and seated lift chairs. Operating from a showroom in Lemoyne, it provides delivery services and in-home setup for customers across Central Pennsylvania, and offers financing through Members First on select showroom items.

The company serves patients and caregivers in Central Pennsylvania needing home respiratory therapy, sleep apnea treatment, and mobility aids. Its customers include individuals requiring oxygen equipment, CPAP supplies, lift chairs, and other durable medical equipment, with a focus on personalized service.

The company states its mission is to deliver personalized, dignified, educational, and compassionate customer care combined with the latest technology. It differentiates itself through a blend of small-town friendly service and state-of-the-art technology, assists customers with funding when needed, and remains involved in community activities.

name: American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant
old_description: With 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities in over a dozen countries worldwide, HOWA is able to meet our customers’ diverse needs on a global scale, while simultaneously responding to the unique demands of our local clientele.
about:
American Howa Kentucky, Inc. Georgetown Plant (AHK‑GT) was established in 2017 in Midway, Kentucky, as the fourth U.S. production site for HOWA USA Holdings, Inc. The Japanese parent, HOWA, operates 33 manufacturing and R&D facilities across over a dozen countries. The Kentucky operation began in 2007 with a plant in Bowling Green, adding sunshade and dash insulator production the following year.

The Georgetown facility manufactures automotive interior components including sunshades, dash insulators, felt, polyurethane foam, headliners, and interior trim. It operates PU foam production lines and supports on‑site headliner production for Nissan programs. The plant is part of a North American network that includes facilities in Bowling Green, Delaware (Ohio), Canton (Mississippi), and Alliston (Ontario).

The plant serves automotive original equipment manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers. Key customers include Nissan North America, Toyota Motor North America, American Honda Motor Co., Aisin World Corp. of America, and Webasto Product North America. Programs supported range from the Nissan Leaf and Frontier to the Murano and Titan, as well as Honda headliner programs.

HOWA's stated mission emphasizes employee well‑being, striving to be the sole manufacturer of unique products through boldness and creativity, building customer confidence via environmental conservation, achieving world‑satisfaction through continuous improvement, and contributing to local development while respecting diverse values.
